name: composer require filament/filament
description: Install the Filament package into a Laravel app
notes: Filament v4 is the current major version (released August 2025)
v4 requires PHP 8.2+, Laravel 11.28+ and Tailwind CSS v4 for custom themes
-W allows Composer to update dependencies Filament needs
Then run php artisan filament:install --panels

name: php artisan filament:install
description: Install and configure Filament panel

flags.description: Set up standalone Filament packages (forms, tables, etc.) in Livewire components without a panel

examples.description: Use Filament components outside of a panel

notes: Creates default admin panel at /admin
Publishes configuration files
Creates a panel provider at app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php and registers it
Then create a login with php artisan make:filament-user

name: php artisan make:filament-panel
description: Create an additional panel (e.g. a customer-facing app next to /admin)

examples.description: Create a panel with ID 'app' served at /app

notes: Creates app/Providers/Filament/AppPanelProvider.php; check it's registered in bootstrap/providers.php
Use --panel=app on other make:filament-* commands to target it

name: php artisan make:filament-user
description: Create a new Filament admin user

flags.description: Panel ID when you have several panels

examples.description: Create a user non-interactively (prompts for the password)

notes: In production, implement FilamentUser::canAccessPanel() on your User model or nobody can log in
Avoid passing --password in shared shells; it stays in history

name: php artisan make:filament-resource
description: Create a new Filament resource

flags.description: Auto-generate form and table fields from database
Create the resource in a specific panel
Namespace of the model if not App\Models

examples.description: Full CRUD with a view page and soft deletes

notes: Creates resource class, pages, and navigation items
Manages CRUD operations for Eloquent models
v4 creates a folder per resource (e.g. app/Filament/Resources/Posts/) with separate Schemas/PostForm and Tables/PostsTable classes; v3 kept everything in PostResource.php
--generate needs doctrine/dbal on Laravel 10 only; on Laravel 11+ it reads the schema natively

name: php artisan make:filament-page
description: Create a new Filament custom page

flags.description: Specify resource to attach page to

notes: Custom pages for admin panel
Can be standalone or attached to resources
Without --resource the page is standalone and appears in the navigation
Run without options to be prompted for the page type

name: php artisan make:filament-cluster
description: Create a cluster that groups resources and pages under one navigation item

examples.description: Create a resource inside a cluster

name: php artisan make:filament-widget
description: Create a new Filament dashboard widget
notes: Display on dashboard or resource pages
Support charts, stats, and tables
Without --resource, widgets go on the dashboard (or any page) when registered

name: php artisan make:filament-relation-manager
description: Create a relation manager for resource

examples.command: php artisan make:filament-relation-manager PostResource comments title
php artisan make:filament-relation-manager UserResource posts title

notes: Manages relationships between models
Displays as tabs on resource pages
Arguments: <Resource> <relationship> <title attribute>; omit them to be prompted

name: php artisan make:filament-theme
description: Create a custom Filament theme

examples.description: Create a theme for the panel with ID 'admin'

notes: v4 themes use Tailwind CSS v4 and create resources/css/filament/<panel>/theme.css
Add the CSS file to the input array in vite.config.js, register it with ->viteTheme() on the panel, then run npm run build

name: php artisan filament:upgrade
description: Refresh Filament after a Composer update (clear caches and republish assets)

examples.description: Run upgrade commands and publish assets
Update within the same major version

notes: Normally runs automatically from the post-autoload-dump script in composer.json
It does not perform a major-version upgrade; for v3 to v4 see the upgrade script (vendor/bin/filament-v4)

name: php artisan filament:assets
description: Publish Filament assets
notes: Useful after upgrading Filament
Publishes to public/vendor/filament

name: vendor/bin/filament-v4
description: Automated upgrade script from Filament v3 to v4

examples.description: Rewrite code for v4 and print the Composer commands to run next
Optional: preview moving resources to the v4 folder structure

notes: Commit first and review the diff; the script doesn't cover every breaking change, so read the v4 upgrade guide
Remove filament/upgrade afterwards with composer remove filament/upgrade --dev

name: php artisan filament:cache-components
description: Cache Filament component configurations
notes: Improves performance in production
Run after deploying
Usually run via php artisan filament:optimize, which also caches Blade icons

name: php artisan filament:clear-cached-components
description: Clear cached Filament components
notes: Use during development when making changes

name: php artisan make:filament-page-action
description: Create a custom page action (not a Filament v3/v4 command)
notes: DEPRECATED/UNSUPPORTED: Filament v3 and v4 don't ship this generator. Define actions inline with Action::make('name') in a page's getHeaderActions() or a table's recordActions()/toolbarActions() (v3: actions()/bulkActions()), or extract a reusable Action subclass by hand

name: php artisan filament:optimize
description: Optimize Filament for production
notes: Runs filament:cache-components and icons:cache; add it to deploy scripts next to php artisan optimize
Undo with php artisan filament:optimize-clear

name: php artisan filament:optimize-clear
description: Clear Filament's cached components and icons
notes: Run when new resources or pages don't show up after filament:optimize

name: php artisan make:filament-table-action
description: Create a custom table action (not a Filament v3/v4 command)
notes: DEPRECATED/UNSUPPORTED: Filament v3 and v4 don't ship this generator. Define actions inline with Action::make('name') in a page's getHeaderActions() or a table's recordActions()/toolbarActions() (v3: actions()/bulkActions()), or extract a reusable Action subclass by hand

name: php artisan make:filament-exporter
description: Create an exporter class for CSV/XLSX export actions

flags.description: Generate columns from the model's database table

notes: Exports run in queued job batches: create the job batches and notifications tables (php artisan make:queue-batches-table, make:notifications-table) and run a queue worker

name: php artisan make:filament-importer
description: Create an importer class for CSV import actions

flags.description: Generate columns from the model's database table

notes: Imports also use queued job batches; a queue worker must be running
